data.narrative: Successfully absorbed two consecutive requirement shocks mid-build (Meridian corporate accounts followed by 3-tier role-based access control) while defending an aggressive 6-day investor demo milestone. Conducted thorough blast radius analyses, layered an adapted Typed Role Model without reverting to scratch, and communicated clear scope trade-offs and compensatory cuts to the PM with zero panic.

strengths: Exhibited exceptional engineering leadership and composure by structuring chaotic mid-build requirement shifts into a disciplined, layered plan without falling into the 'work harder' trap.

Demonstrated rigorous architectural judgment by identifying the exact failure point of naive boolean flags and adopting a clean Typed Role Model that satisfied enterprise requirements while protecting a 6-day delivery milestone.
